title: 第十章 渴望第十一章 这鲍都臭了
lines: 皇宫中的消息永远是最灵通的，但也永远是最不灵通的。
原因很简单。
如果还有希望，值得投资，那么有的是人会因为利益，因为感情，因为把柄通风报信。
可如果看你觉得没啥翻盘点，那么大伙都是守口如瓶。
在金銮殿外。
有的是宫女和太监看见了圣天子左墟大发神威，轰杀禁军，然后徒手捏炮弹施展道术发射出去的神话场景。
这些人在皇宫里透露了风声么？
答案是没有！
他们今天退朝后一个字都没有说！
利益、恐惧和把柄换不来忠诚，但是慷慨的神迹可以。圣天子已经人前显圣了，作为第一批知情者，面圣者，他们是如此的笃定举头三尺有神明，既然如此，那谁敢不敬这位在世的真神呢？
就是这样一个逻辑。
造成了一个非常有趣的现象。
那就是神皇陛下大摇大摆的带着四百号禁军，而且还是戴着甲胄的禁军，在核心正线上列队而行！
如此荒唐，如此悍然，如此逾矩！
别说宫女了，就是那些平日里的掌权太监都不敢上来哭爹喊娘，说什么违背祖宗，是逾矩失礼，是天子失德了。
同样的，也没有任何一个人朝坤宁宫多走一步。
这就是权力。
当力量出现的时候，权就自动靠过来了，不管是不是力量在意或者不在意，自然而然的就该出现在它应该出现的位置，假如不是的话，那么就是力量还不够强！还不够劲！还不够霸！不够彰显！
此刻，皇宫定然已是感受到了左墟的霸念。
就是这片土地，都在畏惧臣服圣天子呀！
这并非夸张或者错觉。
左墟坐在御辇上，龙旗飘扬，华盖威武，整个皇宫的地磁如同活物一般，似复苏似认可，呼应着圣天子的意志。
只不过这种呼应非常非常微弱。
而且目前来看似乎没啥用。
左墟的目光没有目的地瞟向前方两侧。
中轴御道上非常干净，一个人都没有的那么干净，宫女太监们早就提前退至侧廊，实在避无可避的也赶紧转头垂首面向朱墙。
他们知道一场腥风血雨要爆发了。
幸运的是这批冲后宫的禁军没有哄乱，祸及无辜。
丘八们的军纪没有那么好，后宫这种禁地和莺莺燕燕的宫女，自然是让血气方刚，还掌握着主宰生死暴力的汉子们内心骚动。
可只要看一眼圣天子，那些躁动的念头就消失了。
没有为什么。
圣天子，就在那里，在肉眼可见，触手可及，但又遥不可及的御辇上。
一路直行穿过居中的交泰殿，再沿高台御道北行数步，迎面便是坤宁宫朱漆宫门，重檐翘角，规制巍然，正是中宫皇后居所。
左墟脸上的笑容变得愈发灿烂起来。
此时此刻。
坤宁宫寝殿内。
皇后柳令仪正玉体横陈地侧躺在凤榻上。
时近晌午，日头透过坤宁宫寝殿明窗，将满地金砖照得发亮，殿内静得只听见铜漏轻响。
略显燥热的温度似熏的整个坤宁宫不够舒爽，哪怕服侍的宫女手中扇子摇得已经非常勤快了，但皇后还是忍不住一阵莫名心烦。
content_en:
The news in the palace is always the most well-informed, but it is also always the least well-informed.
The reason is simple.
If there is still hope and it is worth investing in, then some people will tip off the information because of interests, feelings, and leverage.
But if you don’t think there’s anything to make a comeback, then everyone is tight-lipped.
Outside the Jinluan Palace.
Some of them were mythical scenes in which palace maids and eunuchs saw the Holy Emperor Zuoxu unleashing his might, killing the Imperial Army, and then using his bare hands to squeeze the cannonballs and use Taoist magic to launch them.
Did these people leak the news in the palace?
The answer is no!
They didn't say a word after retreating from the court today!
Profit, fear, and leverage cannot buy loyalty, but miracles of generosity can. The Holy Emperor has already appeared in front of people. As the first batch of insiders and those who meet the Holy Spirit, they are so sure that there is a god with their heads raised. If this is the case, who dares to disrespect this living true God?
That's the logic.
This resulted in a very interesting phenomenon.
That is His Majesty the God Emperor swaggeringly leading 400 forbidden troops, and they were wearing armor, marching in formation on the core front line!
So absurd, so outrageous, so over the top!
Not to mention the palace maids, even the eunuchs who were usually in charge did not dare to come up to cry for father and mother, saying that they violated the ancestors, were transgressing the rules and disrespected, and the emperor was immoral.
Similarly, no one took one more step towards Kunning Palace.
This is power.
When power appears, Quan will automatically come over. Regardless of whether the power cares or not, it will naturally appear where it should appear. If not, then the power is not strong enough! Not enough! Not domineering enough! Not impressive enough!
At this moment, the imperial palace must have felt Zuo Xu's overbearing thoughts.
Even this land is afraid of surrendering to the Holy Emperor!
This is not an exaggeration or an illusion.
Zuo Xu was sitting on the royal chariot, with the dragon flag flying and the canopy majestic. The geomagnetism of the entire palace was like a living thing, resurrecting and recognizing, echoing the will of the Holy Emperor.
But this response is very, very weak.
And it seems useless so far.
Zuo Xu's eyes glanced aimlessly to both sides in front of him.
The royal road on the central axis was very clean, and no one was so clean. The palace maids and eunuchs had already retreated to the side corridors in advance. If they could not avoid it, they quickly turned their heads and faced the red wall.
They knew a bloody storm was about to break out.
Fortunately, this group of forbidden troops who rushed to the harem did not cause chaos and harm innocent people.
The military discipline of the Qiu Ba people was not that good. The harem, a forbidden area and the maidens, naturally made the men who were strong-blooded and capable of controlling life and death violence feel turbulent.
But as soon as he took one look at the Holy Emperor, those restless thoughts disappeared.
No why.
The Holy Son of Heaven is right there, on the chariot that is visible to the naked eye, within reach, but yet out of reach.
Go straight all the way through the Jiaotai Hall in the middle, and then walk north along the high platform imperial road for a few steps. You will see the red lacquer gate of Kunning Palace directly opposite you.
The smile on Zuo Xu's face became brighter.
At this moment.
Inside the bedroom of Kunning Palace.
Queen Liu Lingyi's jade body lay on her side on the phoenix couch.
It was almost noon, and the sun shined through the open window of Kunning Palace's bedroom, illuminating the gold bricks all over the floor. The palace was so quiet that only the soft sound of copper leaks could be heard.
The slightly hot temperature made the entire Kunning Palace feel uncomfortable. Even though the serving maid was shaking the fan very diligently, the queen couldn't help but feel inexplicably upset.
